mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NAME, STUDENT_NO, PHONE, EMAIL, ROLE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_USERS.NEXTVAL, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{userName}, #{studentNo}, #{phone}, #{email}, 'USER', 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NAME, STUDENT_NO, PHONE, EMAIL, ROLE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM USERS WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
SELECT USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NAME, STUDENT_NO, PHONE, EMAIL, ROLE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
SELECT USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NAME, STUDENT_NO, PHONE, EMAIL, ROLE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET USER_NAME = #{userName}, STUDENT_NO = #{studentNo}, PHONE = #{phone}, EMAIL = #{email}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USERS SET PASSWORD = #{password}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select:
SELECT USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NAME, STUDENT_NO, PHONE, EMAIL, ROLE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM USERS
AND (USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR STUDENT_NO LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND STATUS = #{status}
ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO USER_PUSH_TOKENS T USING ( SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID, #{fcmToken} AS FCM_TOKEN FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.USER_ID = S.USER_ID AND T.FCM_TOKEN = S.FCM_TOKEN) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType}, USE_YN = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TOKEN_ID, USER_ID, FCM_TOKEN, DEVICE_TYPE, USE_YN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_USER_PUSH_TOKENS.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{fcmToken}, #{deviceType}, 'Y', SYSDATE)
